title: Put a program of yours behind the upgrade gate
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Make your gate with `examples/upgrade_gate/adopt.py init`, deploy it to devnet, give your program's upgrade authority to a Squads multisig, and let your build workflow record one build.
evidence: a devnet transaction in which your gate wrote the record ["build", program, executable hash] on a token from a workflow of a repository your account owns, and `adopt.py check` on the program exiting 0
counted_when: the account that did it is not one of Knos's own (scripts/own_github_ids.json); shown as "on tasks Knos funded itself"
